column2: I’ve decided to let it all unfurl.
I just want to sing, and that’s clear.
Just for fun, without a season,
My song makes no real sense,
But I don't mind, it's immense.
I just want to make you smile,
And take you away for a while.
To get the crowd to dance with intent.
It’s just a melody from the heart,
Just for fun, without a season,
